comments.body:
The disconnect is coming from the device turning off its bluetooth during sleep I think. The attempt connection method will only actually try to initiate a connection if the bluetooth device is in the disconnected state already.

If you mean the gatt close, you can control this via the setting `Close GATT on BLE disconnect` in `Settings` -> `Less common Settings` -> `Bluetooth Settings`  - See if that makes any difference?

No I think the main issue is the connect attempt during cmd exchange:
```
09-05 21:05:50.895 16968-16968/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/DexCollectionService: attemptConnection: Connection state: CONNECTED
09-05 21:05:50.900 16968-16968/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/DexCollectionService: attemptConnection: Looks like we are already connected, ready to receive
```

new try by removing options `Close GATT on BLE disconnect` and `close GATT on disconnect` and found something:

good:

```
09-05 22:37:21.080 30223-30348/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/Blukon: block Number is 11
09-05 22:37:21.080 30223-30348/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/Blukon: getNowGlucoseData
09-05 22:37:21.080 30223-30348/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/DexCollectionService: sendBtMessage: entered
09-05 22:37:21.080 30223-30348/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/DexCollectionService: sendBtMessage: sending message: 
                                                                                  0x00000000 01 0D 0E 01 0B                                  .....
09-05 22:37:21.175 9209-9364/? W/bt-btif: HAL bt_gatt_callbacks->client->write_characteristic_cb
09-05 22:37:21.220 9209-9364/? W/bt-btif: HAL bt_gatt_callbacks->client->notify_cb
```

bad:
```
09-05 22:42:22.295 30223-32763/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/Blukon: block Number is 11
09-05 22:42:22.295 30223-32763/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/Blukon: getNowGlucoseData
09-05 22:42:22.300 30223-32763/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/DexCollectionService: sendBtMessage: entered
09-05 22:42:22.300 30223-32763/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/DexCollectionService: sendBtMessage: sending message: 
                                                                                  0x00000000 01 0D 0E 01 0B                                  .....
09-05 22:42:33.410 9209-9364/? W/bt-btif: HAL bt_gatt_callbacks->client->notify_cb
09-05 22:42:33.420 30223-30244/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/DexCollectionService: onCharacteristicChanged entered 
                                                                                  0x00000000 8B 1A 02 00 14                                  .....
09-05 22:42:33.420 30223-30244/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/Blukon: BlueCon data: 8b1a020014
09-05 22:42:33.420 30223-30244/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip E/Blukon: Got NACK on cmd=010d0e010b with error=0014
```

so bt_gatt_callbacks-
If you look at the code path of `attemptConnection()` if the device is already connected it doesn't do anything.
Good catch noticing the write_characteristic_cb missing, try the latest version since this commit: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/05c51872b19c643eb5146e5c5d86844d03d4baf4
Do we think this is resolved now?
I think so, you can close if you want, thank you.
